AGREEMENT PERIOD: This Agreement is valid for a period of 03 year with effect from 01.01.2027 t o 31.12.2029 and may be renewed for a further period, on mutually accepta ble terms and conditions, by both parties in writing. 2. Subject to providing the said Services including any incidental services, t o satisfaction of the Company, the Company agrees to pay a consideratio n amount of Rs………………..(in words) per month per driver which is excl usive of GST (hereinafter referred to as ‘Consideration’) to the Service Pro vider subject to Tax Deduction at Source (TDS). A detailed breakup of the consideration is attached as an Annexure-I to this Agreement and forms a n integral part of this Agreement. b. It is agreed by and between the parties that the consideration of this Agr eement is variable and is subject to change only in accordance with the C entral/State Government notification, circulars, orders or advisory issued t hereto from time to time in relation to rules and regulations governing wa ges or any other regulations from time to time. The service charges mentioned in Annexure-I shall remain fixed till 31.12.2029 As such, no cost escalation of any type shall be allowed oth

er than any statutory changes in the Minimum Wages Act (Changes in DA/ Basic pay etc) or any statutory changes by order/notification of any Gover nment/statutory authority. e. Subject to the Service Provider complying with terms of this Agreement a nd performing the said Services to the satisfaction of the Company, the C ompany shall pay the consideration, in accordance with clause 3 above, upon receipt of correct and valid tax invoice from the Service Provider in accordance with applicable laws, within 10 business days from the date of receipt of the tax invoice and the same shall be subject to deduction of ta x at applicable rates. The payment of consideration shall be subject to ver ification by the company of the amount raised in accordance with the nu mber of days and hours of duty done for each day in the month by the dri ver so deployed. The invoice shall have receipts of statutory payment suc h as PF, ESIC, Gratuity insurance with respect to previous month. f. The Service Provider shall ensure that the salaries to the deployed driver (s) is disbursed by 5th day of the subsequent month, for which invoice is r aised. 4. DUTIES AND OBLIGATIONS OF THE SERVICE PROVIDER: a. The driver deployed at the premises of the Company by the Service Provider sh all be the employee of the Service Provider at all times and the Service Provider shall comply with all the Statutes, Rules, Regulations of the State/Central Govt. and other authorities, which are applicable for the purpose of providing said Ser vices to the Company herein. The Service Provider shall also comply, inter-alia, with all other Central/State Government statutes, rules and requirements including but not limited to the provisions of the Contract Labour (Abolition & C ontrol) Act, Minimum Wages Act, Payment of Wages Act, Payment of Gratuity Ac t, Industrial Disputes Act, Employees Provident Fund and Miscellaneous Provisio ns Act, Employees State Insurance Act, Workmen’s Compensation Act, Contract Labour Regulation, Abolition Act, etc. as amended from time to time. b. The Service Provider shall be solely responsible to maintain all forms, registers, attendance register and other documents required to be maintained under the applicable Central/ State Government statutes, rules and regulations, and shall produce the same for inspection/audit whenever required by the Company or its representative and/or Government officials or any other persons authorized und er various statutes. The said records to be preserved for future reference as per applicable laws.

c. The Service Provider shall also be solely responsible for timely payment of all ta xes, cess, and fees, etc. if any, payable for implementation of this Agreement. d. The Service Provider shall obtain and maintain relevant and sufficient insuranc e coverage for the driver deployed at the Premises of Company and the Compa ny shall not be held liable for any harm and/or accident caused to the personnel employed by the Service Provider during the course of their engagement owing to the negligence of the personnel. e. The Service Provider shall be vicariously liable for all acts, deeds, omissions an d commissions of the driver while deployed at the Company’s Premises for perf ormance of Services under this Agreement. g. The Service Provider shall ensure that all the Rules and Regulations of the Com pany regarding discipline & policies, safety, hygiene and sanitation are complie d with by the driver(s) deployed at the premises of the Company and the timing s are to be strictly adhered to by the driver(s). h. The Service Provider shall be responsible for fulfillment and performance of the obligations under this Agreement. The Service Provider further undertakes to ad here to the Terms and conditions of this Agreement strictly without any lapses o n their part. i. The Service Provider agrees to employ and depute such personnel who have a dequate and appropriate experience in performing their functions and duties at the Premises. The Service Provider agrees not to deploy any personnel at the Pr emises who have had limited or no experience in driving. The drivers deployed at the Premises shall be fully trained and professional in discharging their duties and functions. The Service Provider shall ensure necessary supervision to ensur e the highest level of performance of Services under this Agreement. The Servic e Provider shall be responsible for providing the training that may be required b y the driver in performance of its obligations. j. The Service Provider shall verify the personal bio-data of its driver before deplo ying the driver to the premises of the Company and carry out necessary police v erification of the records provided by the driver. The Service Provider shall ensu re that no person having any criminal record be deployed as a driver under this Agreement. k. fit, active and mentally sound and has proper skill and qualification with valid dr iving license as to perform the Services under this Agreement and should not su ffer from any ailment or chronic diseases. In addition to this, the Service Provide r shall ensure to deploy a sincere and honest driver having good past track reco rd. The Company shall ha ve the right to have any personnel of the Service Provider who is considered to be undesirable or unsuitable removed from the premises immediately. l. The Service Provider shall promptly and timely deposit the statutory benefits like PF, ESI etc. to respective authorities and shall maintain necessary documents / records in support of the above and shall furnish the same to the C ompany on a monthly basis along with invoice for the subsequent month. Any q ueries received from PF office/ ESIC office or from any Central/State Governmen t or regulatory authority to that regard shall be attended to and responded only by the Service Provider from the Effective Date of this Agreement and even afte r expiry of the Agreement. ECGC reserves its right to hold payment of the servic e charges for subsequent months till proof of such remittances is furnished. m. If any facility or benefit required under any Statutes, Rules or Regulations is re quired to be provided by the Service Provider for the benefit of its driver deploy ed at the premises of the Company and the Service Provider fails to provide the same, the Company may insist that the Service Provider provide the same to th e said driver. If the Service Provider fails to do so within a reasonable time, then the Company may provide the said facility and recover all expenses incurred by the Company in providing the said facility from the monthly payments due to th e Service Provider under this agreement. n. The Service Provider and his deployed driver while performing the obligations u nder this Agreement shall ensure that proper care and precaution is taken to pr otect the assets of the Company from loss, destruction, theft, and misuse and s hall ensure that any person not authorized by the Company shall not utilize or h ave access to these assets. In the event of any loss or damage caused to the as sets of the Company by the driver deployed, the Service Provider shall be liable for indemnifying the Company for the loss or damage so caused. o. The Service Provider shall be responsible for arranging for reliever driver to the Company in case of leave or absence (for any reason whatsoever) of the deploy ed Driver for performing his duties. If Service Provider fails to arrange reliever, the Company reserves the right to deduct the payment on a pro-rata basis for s uch period of absence. In such event the Company reserves the right to make n

ecessary alternate arrangements. The Service Provider shall be liable for indem nifying the Company to the extent of cost incurred in making alternate arrange ments. p. In case of termination or expiry of the Agreement, the Service Provider shall ret ain copy of records pertaining to the driver(s) deployed at the Company’s Premi ses for at least 5 years after such termination or expiry. Any relaxation or indulg ence granted by the Company to the Service Provider under this Agreement sha ll not in any way prejudice any of the rights of the Company. q. The Service Provider shall furnish the name, copy of driving license, ID proof an d photos of drivers deployed to work under this Agreement. r. If any complaint arises in respect of Services not properly rendered by the staff / personnel of the Service Provider, the Service Provider shall rectify the same/r edress immediately and without any delay whatsoever, failing which the Compa ny shall be at liberty to exercise its termination rights under this Agreement. Th e Company shall be entitled to monitor and assess the performance of the Servi ce Provider on a continuous basis in order to ensure necessary corrective or pre ventive measures are taken, if the need arises. s. Upon receipt of a notice/information/feedback of unsatisfactory services from t he Company, the Service Provider agrees to fully address and remedy such erro rs within one week of receiving such notice/information/feedback. t. The Service Provider agrees and undertakes that they have not directly or thro ugh any other person or firm offered, promised or given nor shall offer, promise or give, to any employee of ECGC involved in the processing and/or approval of our proposal/offer/bid/tender/contract or to any third person any material or any other benefit which he/she is not legally entitled to, in order to obtain in exchan ge advantage of any kind whatsoever, before or during or after the processing a nd/or approval of our proposal/offer/bid/tender/contract. u. If the deployed driver works beyond 10 hours of duty in a day, t hey will be entitled for overtime payment at the prevailing rate a s mentioned in Annexure – I for every additional hour over and a bove the daily wage. iv. In case of outstation visits, additional charges at the prevailing rate as mentioned in Annexure – I per day would be applicable a nd in case of night retention, prevailing rate as mentioned in Ann exure – I for per night would be applicable over and above the no rmal daily wage. v. Dinner charges at the prevailing rate as mentioned in Annexure – I will be applicable if overtime exceeds beyond 10 pm. d. us Act. 6. TERMINATION: a.
